test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between A and F. Only one person sits between F and E. C sits to the immediate left of D. C is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who is sitting to the immediate left of F?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F.

1) C sits to the immediate left of D.

2) Only two people sit between A and F.

3) C is not an immediate neighbour of A. 

4) Only one person sits between F and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b0c3b2b9b73278e1f5244203a0caf7b455e0881ccb7ecd2f52634a6903d5d5a.png] 

So, **B** is sitting to the immediate left of F

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
